newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Sweden sees July borrowing need 7.8 bln skr.
newsitem.headline: Sweden sees July borrowing need 7.8 bln skr.

text.p: The National Debt Office on Wednesday forecast the state borrowing need at 7.8 billion crowns in July and said it expected to repay 5.1 billion crowns in August.

It left its forecasts for 1997 and 1998 unchanged. The office said earlier it expected a state borrowing need of zero to 10 billion crowns for this year. For 1998 it expected an outcome of between breakeven and repayment of 10 billion crowns.
